catalogMetadata.observedReason: Apple and Proton extension catalog qualification for Chrome, Firefox, Vivaldi, and Floorp on macOS

caveats.nativeHelper: Optional nativeMessaging permission for communication with the Proton Pass desktop app; standalone browser extension operates independently without requiring desktop app or host mutation.
caveats.coexistence: KeePassXC remains primary and built-in stores stay off. Preserve existing settings. First-install trial remains signed out until attended settings disable competing autofill/autosave prompts; use supported manual controls where available. No vault import or automatic passkey-provider change.
caveats.attendedGaps: Initial sign-in requires interactive user authentication with Proton account credentials and 2FA if enabled. Extension is deployed unattended via policy, but authentication state is operator-attended.
caveats.toolbar: Attended browser toolbar pin through the browser extension menu; preserve existing layout and choices.

caveats.nativeHelper: Browser proxy extension; no native helper daemon or host mutation required. Does not modify host routing tables or system VPN tunnels.
caveats.coexistence: Proxy ownership must be checked per browser. No new auto-connect, kill switch, system proxy, host VPN or DNS changes. Normal browsing remains operational if unavailable.
caveats.vpn: Browser-scoped proxy tunnel. The previously observed Vivaldi UI references the official CWS identity; source reference is not installed-instance proof. Reuse the attended-confirmed usable integrated instance or use the official single-instance store route. A different integrated identity requires Vivaldi-only reconciliation.
caveats.attendedGaps: VPN activation and server selection require interactive Proton login and user initiation. No connection is established automatically without user interaction.
caveats.toolbar: Attended browser toolbar pin through the browser extension menu; preserve existing layout and choices.

dns.guidance: Vendor documents Firefox network.trr.mode=3 caveat; maintained DNSOverHTTPS.Enabled=false remains unchanged. Installation is not proof of DNS privacy.

caveats.trafficScope: Only the browser extension traffic; no protection claim for other browsers/apps, Proton Bridge or Vivaldi Mail raw IMAP/SMTP. Preserve localhost/LAN/development; any optional attended connection test restores previous state.

caveats.nativeHelper: Requires the vendor-supported Apple native helper on macOS Sonoma or later. Inventory per-user and system registrations and executable presence; no fixed helper filesystem location is assumed. Native handshake, caller acceptance and pairing remain separate attended checks.
caveats.coexistence: KeePassXC remains primary. No claimed three-way provider priority. Preserve existing settings; pair only attended and decide the supported extension toggle if competing prompts occur. No private database edits or vault import.
caveats.attendedGaps: First-time extension connection requires entry of a 6-digit verification code or biometric approval matching the macOS Keychain prompt. On Floorp or unofficial Gecko builds, Apple native messaging host may refuse connection if code signature validation restricts host callers.
caveats.toolbar: Attended browser toolbar pin through the browser extension menu; preserve existing layout and choices.

updatePolicy.policyRoutes: Official CWS stable IDs and signed AMO latest XPI routes; normal vendor updates permitted
updatePolicy.evidenceProvenance: Gemini bounded catalogue worker official AMO metadata and package manifests; parent verified identities/contracts and public vendor sources; runtime install pending
updatePolicy.trialInstallationMode: normal_installed; default-on with supported user disable toggle; existing required/default-on baseline entries unchanged
updatePolicy.extensionLifecycle: Configuration backups exclude extension data. Releasing install policy or restoring older plists can cause browser-managed removal, reinstallation or pairing loss. Do not promise profile-data preservation from configuration rollback.

otherEcosystemFindings.note: Native app is separate from plan-dependent Pass TOTP; never move the account sole second factor into its dependent vault.
